train_window.prompt: A tall arched art-deco train carriage window seen straight on, a polished brass and ebony frame with gold inlay lines and a small curtain tied back at each side, and through the glass thick glowing teal-green ghostly smoke streaming sideways past in the night with faint pale wisps and drifting sparks. The window stands alone on a plain flat pure white background, centred, no wall, no text.
